title: tc-identifier-details
description: DOIs, IP addresses, file hashes, CVE ids and tracking numbers in text, marked: hover, focus or right-click one for what it is, Copy and what the app knows.

text.description: The text to find identifiers in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

trigger.description: What opens a card: "both" (hover, focus and right-click), "hover" (hover and focus) or "contextmenu" (right-click, Menu key, Enter)

hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer rests on a mark before its card opens, ms

kindLabels.description: What each kind is called on its card, merged over the defaults

notFoundText.description: What the card says when the app knows nothing more

errorText.description: What the card says when the lookup failed

IdentifierKind.description: What can be found: DOIs, IP addresses, file hashes, CVE ids and parcel tracking numbers
